question: What range of reality should be encompassed when meditating on that object in every place?
premises: Meditation is performed in place after place.
The object of meditation is that one.
Its range extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
inference: One should meditate on that object in every place as pervading from Śiva down to Avīci.
plain_english: Having meditated on that in place after place, one should see it extending from Śiva down to Avīci.
